# MagnusBilling 7 - Full AI Documentation Catalog

Complete machine-oriented index for LLMs, coding agents, and RAG ingestion.

Project: MagnusBilling 7
Repository: https://github.com/magnussolution/magnusbilling7
Branch path used by docs: https://github.com/magnussolution/magnusbilling7/tree/source

## Purpose

Use this file when you need a complete map of MagnusBilling AI docs,
playbooks, source traceability files, retrieval indexes, and high-signal
code entry points.

## Source Priority Policy

1. Current code in repository is authoritative.
2. Curated IA docs (domains and playbooks) are secondary truth.
3. Video-transcript knowledge is contextual guidance.
4. If conflict exists, prefer current code behavior and note discrepancy.

## Supported Question Space (for AI routing)

- Authentication and session
- Call flow and billing logic
- Rates and provider costs
- DID, queue, IVR, and inbound routing
- SIP/IAX account setup and diagnostics
- Payments, refill, invoices, and reports
- Campaigns and massive calls
- Contact center and queue operations
- System entry points and command jobs

## Search Keywords

MagnusBilling, Asterisk, VoIP billing, AGI, Yii1, ExtJS, CDR, DID, IVR,
queue, trunk, SIP, IAX, refill, invoice, call routing, tariff, prefix,
provider, campaign, cron jobs, support triage, diagnostics.
